text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 873 January 12, 1976
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 342 BY DESIGNATING A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE
OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT, IN LIEU OF THE ABOLISHED POSITION OF THE EXECUTIVE
SECRETARY, AS ONE OF THE MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE CENTER FOR ADVANCED
STUDIES BOARD OF TRUSTEES
Presidential Decree No. 342 is hereby amended by designating a "Representative of the Office of the
President," in lieu of the abolished position of the Executive Secretary, as one of the members of the PCAS
Board of Trustees. The representative shall be appointed by the President.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
